title: Translate into French
intro: Five at a time, picked at random — the same as the real test.

items.prompt: I live in Bridgend, in Wales.
items.answer: J'habite à Bridgend, au Pays de Galles.

items.prompt: In the future I would like to live in Spain.
items.answer: Dans le futur, je voudrais habiter en Espagne.

items.prompt: I am very well, thank you. And you?
items.answer: Ça va très bien, merci. Et toi ?
